title: LM Checklist Assertions (YAML)
description: Upload format: YAML file (matches SEVAL's AssertionSet.fromYAML). The JSON Schema below describes the in-memory shape after YamlValidator converts the YAML into a JSON object — it is NOT the upload format. Each item is either a QueryElement (has `query` + `assertions`) or a TagElement (has `tag`), mirroring SEVAL's AssertionSet discriminator. Required-field set for QueryElement aligned with SEVAL's LMChecklistCreateDataSchema: only `query` and `assertions` are mandatory; everything else (`id`, `segmentOne`, `segmentTwo`, `queryOwner`, `environment`, `term`, `sets`, `label`) is optional.

id.description: Unique identifier for the checklist item

tag.description: TagElement name. Items with a non-empty `tag` (and no `query`) are TagElements — group markers referenced by QueryElement.tags[]. Mirrors SEVAL's AssertionSet TagElement branch.

tags.description: Tag references — used by both QueryElement (tagging a query) and TagElement (hierarchical tag composition).

description.description: Optional human-readable description (commonly used on TagElements).

environment.description: Target environment. SEVAL enforces an enum of exactly 'MSIT' or 'Test Tenant' (LMChecklistCreateDataSchema rule 1.A.4 in docs/SchemaService/SEVAL-Validation-Rules-And-Coverage-Gap.md). Any other value — e.g. 'SEVAL' or 'Production' — causes SEVAL to fail the job with LMchecklistInputFileError-BadData (see bug 7360037 / ICM 796617307).

term.description: Term classification (e.g., Short Term, Medium Term, Long Term)

label.description: JSON string with tool configurations (avalon_tools, sydcomp_tools)

text.description: LLMAssertion text — natural-language statement evaluated by an LLM judge. SEVAL requires it to be a non-empty string.

test.description: PythonAssertion path — Pythonic test function path (e.g. citations_test.test_citation). SEVAL requires it to be a non-empty string.

examples.description: Few-shot examples to ground the LLM judge. SEVAL's AssertionSet parser enforces per-Example constraints (Example.fromDict — rules 1.A.8 / 1.A.9 / 1.A.10 in docs/SchemaService/SEVAL-Validation-Rules-And-Coverage-Gap.md).

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation for the score. SEVAL: 'The value for rationale should be a non-empty str.'

score.description: Example score. SEVAL: 'score should be an integer between 0 and 2.'

response.description: Optional sample response. When present, SEVAL requires it to be non-empty.

calibrationEntities.description: Calibration ground truth used to score the assertion. SEVAL's CalibrationObj parser enforces the humanLabel range (rule 1.A.11).

humanLabel.description: Human-assigned calibration label. SEVAL: 'humanLabel should be an integer between 0 and 2.'
